name: script_reads_a_listed_host
title: A script reads a public JSON endpoint on the module's list

steps.say: In the shell, with a short Python script (not WebFetch), read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users and put each user's name and email into my Users table, with that URL as the source.
steps.reply: I added all 10 users to your Users table with their names and emails. I read them with a short Python script in the shell, and each row has https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users as its source. Rows are matched on email, so running this again will update them rather than add copies.
